get.description: Recent activity for the authenticated account, newest first, already scoped and redacted by the server. Cursors are opaque (1 to 512 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . = : ~). A response that repeats the request cursor ends pagination. Clients send X-Request-Id, an opaque random id, for support correlation.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.description: Aggregated, sample-free CSP violation groups for the caller's organization. Groups never include blocked URIs, document URLs, source files, script samples, DOM content, referrers, tokens or user input. Cursors are opaque (1 to 512 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . = : ~). Restricted to organization administrators.

post.description: Server authorizes the current account, binds both single-use wallet challenges to the same intent, role and network, validates signatures, enforces expiry and version, checks replacement-account conflicts, and atomically completes reassignment/session invalidation. Challenge issuance does not change the intent version. See docs/wallet-rotation-server-recovery.md for canonical signing text. Never log signatures or wallet material.

checkpointId.description: Reference to the checkpoint this observation belongs to

observationType.description: What type of verification was performed

result.description: True if this observation passed, false if it failed

details.description: Optional detailed explanation of the observation result

order.description: Sequence order in the verification chain (0-indexed)

description.example: Verify that the issuer is in the trusted registry

retryable.description: Whether this source might be available if retried

sources.description: All sources that contributed to verification

verificationPath.description: Ordered list of checkpoints that were executed

missingLinks.description: Sources that could not be verified (empty list if all sources were checked)

provenance.description: Verification source provenance chain showing which sources contributed to the verification decision

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp. Absent/null for keys created before this field existed; the UI must render an explicit unavailable state rather than guessing.

ActivityEvent.description: Redacted activity event. Only the masked field matching the category is present. Unknown categories or actions may appear and are shown as an unrecognized event.
